recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow consistency correction for the same normative table/code-system relationship covered by FHIR-37849; handle FHIR-42956 separately if broader status/inactive prose is later applied.
issue_request: FHIR-37849 was Published with a Persuasive R5 resolution to reconcile section 4.8.12 with the http://hl7.org/fhir/concept-properties code system, retain the table, add codes in both places, deprecate the old deprecated property code, and omit deprecated from the table.
initial_application: Commit bad31b070fe6703f221a0c60357e2d0cde9c5938 applied the issue by adding status, effectiveDate, deprecationDate, and retirementDate to the Concept Properties CodeSystem and corresponding table rows. Later work added explicit dataType values and more concept-property rows, leaving the table with stale date/string datatype text, two wrong clipboard URIs, and one deprecationDate value encoded as valueCode.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes concept-properties under [codesystems], and CodeSystem is an active resource, so both edited files feed the current build. FHIR-48428 made concept-property datatypes explicit and bound them to ValueSet/concept-property-type; FHIR-44627 deprecated synonym and added its deprecationDate metadata; FHIR-50433 added replacedByCode and replacedByCoding; FHIR-42956 is later status/inactive clarification work that is not applied/published in this run scope.
reconciliation: Changed the CodeSystem table types for effectiveDate, deprecationDate, and retirementDate from date to dateTime, corrected the deprecationDate and retirementDate clipboard URIs, changed the grouped replacedBy[X] type from string to code or Coding, and changed synonym's deprecationDate value from valueCode to valueDateTime.
source_changes: source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml: aligned affected table datatype cells, fixed deprecationDate and retirementDate copy URIs, and corrected the replacedBy[X] grouped type.
source/codesystem/codesystem-concept-properties.xml: encoded synonym's deprecationDate property value as valueDateTime to match the declared dateTime datatype.

related_jiras.note: Made dataType values explicit and bound them to concept-property-type, establishing dateTime as the formal datatype for the affected date-valued properties.
Deprecated synonym and added its deprecationDate value; this reconciliation corrected that value to use the declared dateTime choice type.
Added replacedByCode and replacedByCoding; this reconciliation aligned the grouped table row with their code and Coding datatypes.
Later Resolved - change required clarification about status versus inactive; not applied/published in this run scope and not needed for this datatype fix.
